42201.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 137 = 128 + 9, ya'ni jarayon SIGKILL bilan o'ldirilgan — shuning uchun ilova log yozishga ulgurmagan. Eng ko'p sabab — memory limitga urilib OOM kill. Avval `docker inspect` dagi `OOMKilled` ni tekshiring, keyin xotira sarfini o'lchang.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app xotirasi o'sadi -> cgroup memory.max ga yetadi
  -> kernel OOM killer -> SIGKILL -> Exited (137), OOMKilled=true
Boshqa yo'l: docker stop timeout / docker kill / host OOM -> 137, OOMKilled=false
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}} {{.State.ExitCode}} {{.HostConfig.Memory}}' api
# true 137 536870912
docker stats --no-stream api
docker events --since 1h --filter container=api --filter event=oom
dmesg -T | grep -iE 'oom|killed process'
# Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 4121 (api) total-vm:... anon-rss:524000kB
```

| Natija | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `OOMKilled=true` | container limitiga urildi |
| `false` + `docker stop` bo'lgan | SIGTERM ushlanmadi, 10s keyin SIGKILL |
| `false` + dmesg'da host OOM | host'da RAM tugagan |

**Sabablar va fix:**
- Limit kichik — peak + 20-30% zaxira.
- Memory leak — pprof/heap dump bilan topish (`go tool pprof http://.../debug/pprof/heap`).
- Runtime limitni bilmaydi: Go `GOMEMLIMIT` (limitning ~80-90%), JVM `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75`.
- tmpfs / `/dev/shm` ham RAM'dan yeydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Limitni oshirish leak'ni davolamaydi — faqat o'limni kechiktiradi.
- `docker stats` o'rtacha holatni ko'rsatadi — qisqa peak'lar ko'rinmaydi; metrikani grafikda kuzating.
- Page cache ham hisobga kiradi — fayl I/O ko'p ilovada xotira "o'sgandek" ko'rinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** OOM'ni monitoring qiling (`container_oom_events_total`, restart soni) va alert qo'ying. Root cause — limit emas, xotira profili: o'lchang, keyin qaror qiling.

42202.a:
**Debug:**
```sh
docker exec api cat /etc/resolv.conf
docker run --rm busybox nslookup google.com
docker run --rm --dns 10.0.0.2 busybox nslookup internal.corp
```
**Ko'p sabablar:**
- Host `nameserver 127.0.0.53` (systemd-resolved). Loopback container namespace'ida boshqa — Docker uni ko'chirmaydi, 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4 qo'yadi. Korporativ firewall tashqi DNS'ni yopgan, ichki domen ham ko'rinmaydi.
- Firewall/`iptables` qayta yuklanib Docker NAT qoidalari o'chgan (container umuman internetga chiqmaydi).
- VPN DNS faqat host'ga qo'yilgan.

**Fix:** `/etc/docker/daemon.json`:
```json
{ "dns": ["10.0.0.2", "10.0.0.3"] }
```
keyin `systemctl restart docker`. User-defined network'da Docker embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) service nomlarini hal qiladi, tashqi so'rovni shu upstream'ga uzatadi.

42203.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Docker default'da `172.17.0.0/16` (docker0) va `172.18+.x.x` (user-defined tarmoqlar) subnet'larini oladi. Ofis/VPN tarmog'i ham shu diapazonda bo'lsa, kernel route jadvalida docker bridge'ga mos route ustun keladi va paketlar VPN'ga emas, docker bridge'ga ketadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ip route:
  default via 192.168.1.1 dev eth0
  172.16.0.0/12 dev tun0          (VPN)
  172.18.0.0/16 dev br-ab12       (docker) <- aniqroq prefix, shu tanlanadi
172.18.5.10 (ofis server) -> br-ab12 -> hech qayerga
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ip route | grep -E 'docker0|br-'
docker network ls
docker network inspect $(docker network ls -q) --format '{{.Name}} {{range .IPAM.Config}}{{.Subnet}}{{end}}'
```
Fix — `/etc/docker/daemon.json`:
```json
{
  "bip": "10.200.0.1/24",
  "default-address-pools": [{ "base": "10.201.0.0/16", "size": 24 }]
}
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart docker
docker network prune          # eski user-defined tarmoqlar (container'lar to'xtatilgan bo'lsin)
docker compose down && docker compose up -d   # Compose tarmoqlari qayta yaratiladi
```
Compose'da aniq subnet:
```yaml
networks:
  default:
    ipam:
      config: [{ subnet: 10.201.5.0/24 }]
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat `bip` ni o'zgartirish — user-defined va Compose tarmoqlari baribir 172.x dan oladi.
- Eski tarmoqlar o'chirilmasa route qoladi.
- Har Compose loyiha yangi /16 oladi — pool tez tugaydi (`size: 24` buni hal qiladi).

**Senior nuqta:** Docker IP pool'ini korporativ IP rejasiga kiriting va golden image/Ansible orqali oldindan sozlang. Bu klassik "Docker o'rnatgandan keyin VPN ishlamay qoldi" incident'i.

42204.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Default'da dockerd to'xtaganda u boshqarayotgan barcha container'larni ham to'xtatadi. `daemon.json` da `"live-restore": true` yoqilsa, daemon restart/upgrade paytida container'lar `containerd-shim` ostida ishlashda davom etadi va daemon qaytgach qayta ulanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
live-restore: false   dockerd stop -> barcha container stop -> downtime
live-restore: true    dockerd stop -> shim + process ishlayveradi
                      dockerd start -> container'larni qayta "topadi"
```

**Amalda:**
```json
{ "live-restore": true }
```
```bash
sudo systemctl reload docker          # SIGHUP, restart shart emas
docker info | grep -i 'live restore'  # Live Restore Enabled: true
sudo systemctl restart docker
docker ps                             # container'lar Up, uptime o'zgarmagan
```
Reboot uchun ham:
```bash
docker update --restart unless-stopped $(docker ps -q)
```

**Cheklovlar:**
- Major versiya upgrade'da kafolat yo'q (API/format o'zgarishi).
- Swarm mode bilan mos emas.
- Daemon uzoq yo'q bo'lsa, log buffer to'lib ilova stdout'ga yozishda bloklanishi mumkin.
- Daemon o'chiq paytida port mapping (userland-proxy), DNS ishlamasligi mumkin.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `restart` emas, `reload` yetarli bo'lganda ham restart qilish.
- `apt upgrade` docker paketini avtomatik yangilashi — `apt-mark hold docker-ce containerd.io`.
- live-restore'ni HA o'rnini bosadi deb o'ylash.

**Senior nuqta:** live-restore — yumshatish, yechim emas. Production'da bitta host'ga tayanmang: 2+ host + LB, host'larni navbat bilan yangilash (drain -> upgrade -> qaytarish) yoki orchestrator.

42205.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Image layer'lari append-only: `COPY .env` alohida layer bo'lib image ichida qoladi, keyingi `RUN rm .env` faqat yangi layer'da "whiteout" yozadi — fayl yashiriladi, lekin o'chmaydi. Image'ni pull qilgan har kim `docker save` bilan uni chiqarib oladi. Bu — secret leak incident.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
layer 4: RUN rm .env    -> whiteout (.env yashirin)
layer 3: COPY .env      -> .env fayli SHU YERDA, tar ichida
layer 2..1: base
```

**Amalda (tekshirish):**
```bash
docker history --no-trunc app:1.4
docker save app:1.4 -o img.tar && mkdir img && tar -xf img.tar -C img
for l in img/blobs/sha256/*; do tar -tf "$l" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.env$' && echo "$l"; done
```

**Incident tartibi:**
1. Key'ni **darhol revoke/rotate** — image registry'da qancha joyga pull qilinganini bilmaysiz.
2. Audit: provider log'larida key ishlatilganmi.
3. Image'ni registry'dan o'chiring, cache/mirror'larni ham.
4. To'g'ri usul bilan qayta build.

**To'g'ri usul:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci
```
```bash
docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .
```
Va `.dockerignore` ga `.env`, `.env.*`. Runtime secret — env/secret store orqali, image'ga emas.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Squash qilish yoki image'ni o'chirish — leak'ni bekor qilmaydi; rotatsiya majburiy.
- Multi-stage builder bosqichida secret ishlatish — final image'da yo'q, lekin cache/registry cache'da qolishi mumkin.
- `ARG TOKEN` ham `docker history` da ko'rinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Preventiv nazorat: CI'da `trivy image --scanners secret` va gitleaks, `.dockerignore` allowlist. "Secret image'ga tegdimi — u kompromat" qoidasi.

42206.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Eng ehtimolli sabab — CPU throttling. `--cpus` CFS kvotasini belgilaydi: har 100ms davrda faqat N ms CPU. Ko'p thread'li ilova kvotani davr boshida yeb bo'ladi va qolgan vaqt kutadi. O'rtacha CPU 50% ko'rinadi, lekin so'rovlar har davrda muzlaydi — p99 oshadi. `cpu.stat` dagi `nr_throttled` ni tekshiring.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
--cpus=1 -> 100ms davrda 100ms CPU vaqti
8 thread x 12.5ms = 100ms  -> kvota 12.5ms da tugadi
|##|..........kutish 87ms..........|##|....
so'rov shu kutishga tushsa -> +87ms latency
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker exec api cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat     # cgroup v2
# nr_periods 12000
# nr_throttled 4100      <- ~34% davrda throttle
# throttled_usec 98000000
docker inspect api --format '{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}'
```
`nr_throttled / nr_periods` > 5-10% — muammo.

**Fix:**
- Go: `GOMAXPROCS` = limit (Go 1.25+ cgroup'ni avtomatik hisobga oladi; eskida `go.uber.org/automaxprocs`).
- JVM: container-aware versiya, GC/thread pool sonini kamaytirish (`-XX:ActiveProcessorCount`).
- Limitni oshirish yoki latency-sensitive servisda CPU limitni olib, faqat reservation qoldirish.

**Boshqa sabablar (throttle yo'q bo'lsa):**
- Disk I/O (`iostat -x`, `docker stats` BLOCK I/O).
- Noisy neighbor host'da (`top`, steal time).
- Har so'rovda DNS lookup (alpine/musl, `ndots`).
- GC pauzalari, lock contention — profiler (pprof).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `docker stats` dagi CPU% — o'rtacha; throttling uni ko'rsatmaydi.
- `GOMAXPROCS` = host yadrolari (64) va `--cpus=2` — eng yomon kombinatsiya.

**Senior nuqta:** Latency SLO'li servislar uchun CPU throttling metrikasi (`container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total`) dashboard'da bo'lishi shart. O'rtacha emas, percentile va throttling'ga qarab qaror qiling.

42207.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker ps` qotishi odatda daemon muammosi: `/var/lib/docker` diski yoki inode'lari to'lgan, PID/thread limiti tugagan, yoki containerd/shim'lar osilib qolgan. Avval daemon log'lari, keyin disk/inode, keyin PID'lar.

**Qanday ishlaydi (tekshiruv tartibi):**
```
1. journalctl docker/containerd  -> xato matni nima?
2. df -h / df -i                 -> joy va inode
3. eng katta json log'lar
4. PID/thread soni, zombie'lar
5. dmesg                         -> kernel xatolari (OOM, I/O)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
journalctl -u docker -u containerd --since -30m | tail -50
df -h /var/lib/docker; df -i /var/lib/docker
du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail
cat /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max; ps -eLf | wc -l
ps -eo stat | grep -c Z            # zombie soni
dmesg -T | tail -30
timeout 5 docker info || echo "daemon javob bermayapti"
```

| Belgi | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `no space left on device` | disk to'la (log, image, build cache) |
| `df -i` 100% | inode tugagan (ko'p kichik fayl) |
| `fork: Resource temporarily unavailable` | PID/thread limit |
| ko'p `Z` | `--init` yo'q, zombie'lar |

**Tezkor yumshatish:**
```bash
truncate -s 0 /var/lib/docker/containers/<id>/<id>-json.log
docker image prune -f; docker builder prune -f
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Log faylini `rm` qilish — dockerd uni ochiq ushlab turadi, joy bo'shamaydi.
- `systemctl restart docker` — `live-restore` siz hamma container o'ladi.
- `/var/lib/docker` ni qo'lda tozalash — metadata buziladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Doimiy yechim: log rotation (`max-size/max-file`), `--pids-limit`, `--init`, alohida disk `/var/lib/docker` uchun, disk 80% va inode alertlari. Bitta host'da 40 ta container — fail domain katta; orkestratsiya haqida o'ylang.

42208.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikki sabab: (1) container'larda `restart` policy yo'q (default `no`), (2) Docker daemon o'zi boot'da yoqilmagan (`systemctl enable docker` qilinmagan). Fix: `restart: unless-stopped` qo'shib `docker compose up -d` (recreate) va daemon'ni enable qilish.

**Muammo:** Kernel update'dan keyin server reboot bo'ldi, sayt tushdi, kimdir ertalab qo'lda `up -d` qildi. Compose o'zi daemon emas — reboot'da hech narsani ko'tarmaydi; buni dockerd restart policy bo'yicha qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
boot -> systemd -> docker.service (enabled?) -> dockerd
          -> har container: RestartPolicy?
               no             -> ko'tarilmaydi
               unless-stopped -> ko'tariladi (qo'lda stop qilinmagan bo'lsa)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl is-enabled docker        # disabled bo'lsa:
sudo systemctl enable --now docker
docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' shop-api-1   # no
```
```yaml
services:
  api:
    restart: unless-stopped
```
```bash
docker compose up -d     # policy container yaratilishida yoziladi -> recreate kerak
sudo reboot              # sinab ko'r
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- YAML'ga `restart` qo'shib, recreate qilmaslik — eski container'da policy o'zgarmaydi.
- `depends_on` reboot'da hisobga olinmaydi — dockerd hammasini parallel ko'taradi; api DB'ga retry bilan ulanishi kerak.
- Rootless Docker'da `systemctl --user enable docker` + `loginctl enable-linger`.

**Senior nuqta:** Reboot — sinalishi kerak bo'lgan stsenariy: maintenance oynasida rejali reboot qilib tekshir. systemd unit (`ExecStart=docker compose up`) mumkin, lekin ko'pincha restart policy yetarli va soddaroq.

42209.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Compose container'larni `com.docker.compose.project` label bo'yicha kuzatadi. Service YAML'dan olib tashlansa yoki nomi o'zgarsa, eski container avtomatik o'chmaydi — "orphan" bo'lib qoladi va portni ushlab turadi. Yechim: ro'yxatni ko'rib, `docker compose up -d --remove-orphans`.

**Muammo:** `web` service `frontend` ga qayta nomlandi. Yangi `frontend` 80-portga bog'lanolmaydi — eski `shop-web-1` hali ishlayapti.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
YAML: api, frontend
Label project=shop: api-1, web-1 (orphan!), frontend-1 (port band -> xato)
--remove-orphans -> web-1 to'xtatilib o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop \
  --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Label "com.docker.compose.service"}}\t{{.Ports}}'
docker compose up -d --remove-orphans
ss -tlnp | grep ':80 '    # endi kim tinglayapti
```

**Boshqa sabab:** ikki papkada bir xil nomli loyiha (project name = papka nomi, masalan ikkalasi `app/`). Biri ikkinchisining container'larini orphan deb ko'radi. Yechim: faylda `name: shop-api` yoki `-p`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--remove-orphans` ishlab turgan servisni to'xtatadi — prod'da avval ro'yxatni ko'r.
- U volume'ni o'chirmaydi, lekin orphan'ning anonymous volume'lari osilib qoladi (`docker volume prune` ehtiyot bilan).
- Ogohlantirishni e'tiborsiz qoldirish — eski versiya trafikning bir qismini olib qolishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy skriptiga `--remove-orphans` qo'shish mumkin, lekin faqat project nomi qat'iy bo'lsa — aks holda qo'shni loyihani o'chirib yuborasan.

42210.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Odatda healthcheck noto'g'ri yoki juda erta "healthy" deydi (masalan, Postgres init paytida vaqtinchalik server), yoki api noto'g'ri host/port'ga ulanyapti. Yechim: to'g'ri healthcheck (`pg_isready -U user -d db`, `start_period`), `condition: service_healthy`, ilovada retry/backoff va `restart: unless-stopped`.

**Muammo:** Birinchi start'da postgres image init skriptlarini vaqtinchalik server bilan bajaradi, so'ng uni to'xtatib, haqiqiy serverni ko'taradi. `pg_isready` aynan o'sha oraliqda "ok" deyishi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
db: init server (unix socket) -> init.sql -> stop -> real server (tcp 5432)
healthcheck:  ok?  ......  ok -> api start -> tcp ulanish -> refused!
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
  api:
    depends_on:
      db: { condition: service_healthy }
    restart: unless-stopped
```
`-h 127.0.0.1` — TCP orqali tekshiradi (init paytida faqat unix socket ochiq). Debug:
```bash
docker compose ps
docker inspect -f '{{json .State.Health}}' shop-db-1 | jq
docker compose exec api getent hosts db
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `$$` — Compose interpolatsiyasidan qochish; `$POSTGRES_USER` host env'dan olinib bo'sh bo'ladi.
- api'da `localhost:5432` — container o'zi.
- Migratsiyani api start'ga qo'shish — alohida `migrate` service + `service_completed_successfully` yaxshiroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Ilova birinchi ulanishda yiqilmasin — retry with backoff (masalan 30 s ichida). Bu Compose, K8s va DB failover'da bir xil ishlaydi; healthcheck faqat qo'shimcha.

42211.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `up -d` o'zgargan service'ni **recreate** qiladi: eski container to'xtaydi, keyin yangisi start bo'ladi — app start + warm-up vaqti = downtime. Qisqartirish: pull'ni alohida bajarish, graceful shutdown, tez startup, va to'liq yo'qotish uchun reverse proxy + 2 nusxa (rolling) yoki blue/green.

**Muammo:** Har deploy'da 20-30 s 502. Kun ichida 5 deploy = foydalanuvchilar sezadi, SLA buziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
eski: [ishlayapti]--stop(SIGTERM..grace)--X
yangi:                                     start--init--warm--[tayyor]
                     |<------ downtime 20-30s ------>|
```

**Amalda:**
1. Image oldindan: `docker compose pull` (deploy vaqtidan tashqarida).
2. Graceful: SIGTERM'ni ushla, in-flight so'rovlarni tugat; `stop_grace_period: 30s`.
3. Rolling: `docker rollout api` (plugin) — yangi nusxa healthy bo'lgach eskisi o'chadi.
4. Blue/green:
```bash
docker compose up -d api_green
until [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' shop-api_green-1)" = healthy ]; do sleep 2; done
sed -i 's/api_blue/api_green/' nginx/upstream.conf
docker compose exec nginx nginx -s reload     # reload = uzilishsiz
docker compose stop api_blue
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Healthcheck'siz switch — tayyor bo'lmagan versiyaga trafik.
- Backward-incompatible DB migratsiya — blue/green bir vaqtda ishlaganda buziladi.
- nginx `restart` (reload emas) — o'zi downtime beradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Qaror mezoni: deploy chastotasi va SLA. Ular oshsa Compose chegarasiga yetding — Swarm `update_config: order: start-first` yoki K8s rolling update buni o'rnatilgan beradi.

42212.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `down -v` bilan o'chgan named volume Docker'dan qaytmaydi — faqat backup'dan restore. Keyin oldini olish: volume'ni `external: true` qilish, avtomatik backup (pg_dump/pgBackRest/WAL-G) + offsite, restore'ni muntazam sinash, prod buyruqlarini skriptga o'rash.

**Muammo:** Staging'ni tozalamoqchi edi, terminal prod serverda ochiq edi. Bir buyruq — butun DB ketdi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
down -v -> volume shop_pgdata o'chirildi (rm -rf /var/lib/docker/volumes/...)
restore: yangi volume -> db start -> backup.sql.gz -> psql
oldini olish: external volume -> Compose uni boshqarmaydi -> down -v tegmaydi
```

**Amalda (hozir):**
```bash
docker compose up -d db                       # yangi bo'sh volume
gunzip -c backup-2026-10-02.sql.gz | docker compose exec -T db psql -U app app
docker compose exec db psql -U app -c 'select count(*) from orders;'
```
**Oldini olish:**
```bash
docker volume create shop_pgdata
```
```yaml
volumes:
  pgdata:
    external: true
    name: shop_pgdata
```
Backup cron:
```bash
docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U app -Fc app > /backup/app-$(date +%F).dump
aws s3 cp /backup/app-$(date +%F).dump s3://acme-backups/pg/
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Backup bor, lekin restore hech qachon sinalmagan — "tekshirilmagan backup = backup yo'q".
- Backup o'sha serverda — disk o'lsa ikkalasi ketadi.
- pg_dump faqat kunlik — oxirgi 23 soat yo'qoladi; RPO kichik bo'lsa WAL arxivi (PITR) kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Postmortem'da aybdor emas, tizim: buyruqni kim yozganidan qat'i nazar, bitta xato bilan prod data o'chmasligi kerak. Muhim DB uchun managed (RDS/Cloud SQL) yoki kamida PITR'li backup ko'rib chiq.

42213.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Update `paused` — Swarm yangi task'lar ishlamaganini sezib to'xtadi (`failure_action: pause`). Avval yangi task'lar xatosini (`service ps --no-trunc`), update holatini (`inspect`) va log'ni ko'r; tezkor mitigatsiya — `docker service rollback`.

**Muammo:** Prod'da yarim replika yangi versiyada osilib qoldi, yarimi eski — sig'im kamaygan va aralash versiya.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
update: v1 v1 v1 -> v2(Rejected) -> failure -> pause
                                         -> yoki rollback (sozlangan bo'lsa)
UpdateStatus.State: updating | paused | completed | rollback_completed
```

**Amalda:**
```sh
docker service ps api --no-trunc --filter desired-state=shutdown
docker service ps api --no-trunc --format '{{.Name}} {{.Node}} {{.CurrentState}} {{.Error}}'
docker service inspect api --format '{{json .UpdateStatus}}'
docker service logs api --tail 100
docker service rollback api        # tezkor qaytish
```

| Xato | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `No such image` | registry auth — `--with-registry-auth` |
| `insufficient resources` | `reservations` sig'maydi (start-first + to'la node) |
| `no suitable node` | yangi constraint/label |
| task Running -> Failed (healthcheck) | yangi versiya bug yoki `start_period` kichik |

**Oldini olish:**
```yaml
deploy:
  update_config: { parallelism: 1, delay: 10s, order: start-first, failure_action: rollback, monitor: 30s }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Paused holatda `service update` qayta qilish xato sababini tuzatmaydi.
- `start-first` qo'shimcha resurs talab qiladi — to'la klasterda faqat shu sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Avval mitigate (rollback), keyin root cause. CI'da `--detach=false` — muvaffaqiyatsiz update pipeline'ni qizil qilsin, inson kech bilmasin.

42214.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Eng ko'p sabab — **firewall**: 7946/tcp+udp (gossip) yoki 4789/udp (VXLAN) yangi node'ga yopiq. Ikkinchi sabab — **MTU**: cloud/VPN'da overlay paketlari katta bo'lib, kichik so'rov o'tadi-yu katta javob osiladi.

**Muammo:** `docker node ls` da node `Ready` — chunki join faqat 2377/tcp'dan foydalanadi. Lekin data plane boshqa portlarda ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**

| Port | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| 2377/tcp | cluster management (manager'ga) |
| 7946/tcp+udp | node discovery / gossip (network peer ro'yxati) |
| 4789/udp | VXLAN overlay data |
| IP proto 50 (ESP) | `--opt encrypted` overlay |

```
task(node-new) --VXLAN udp/4789--> node2   <- firewall DROP => timeout
```

**Amalda:**
```sh
docker node ls                                   # Ready/Active?
docker network inspect backend --verbose         # Peers ro'yxatida yangi node bormi?
nc -zv node2 7946 ; nc -zvu node2 7946 ; nc -zvu node2 4789
sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 udp port 4789             # paket kelyaptimi
ip link show eth0 | grep mtu
# MTU tuzatish
docker network create -d overlay \
  --opt com.docker.network.driver.mtu=1400 backend2
```
MTU testi: `ping -M do -s 1400 <ip>` — o'tmasa, kichraytir.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cloud security group'da UDP alohida qoida — faqat TCP ochilgan bo'ladi.
- 4789/udp'ni internetga ochma — VXLAN autentifikatsiyasiz, begona paket injection.
- Node'ning `--advertise-addr` noto'g'ri (public IP) — peer'lar xato manzilga yuboradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Node bootstrap'ni (firewall, MTU, advertise-addr) IaC'da standartlashtir va join'dan keyin avtomatik smoke test: `tasks.<svc>` ga ping/curl.

42215.a:
**Qisqa javob:** 3 tadan quorum = 2; bitta manager qolsa Raft yoza olmaydi — yangi deploy/update ishlamaydi, lekin **mavjud task'lar ishlashda davom etadi**. Avval o'chgan manager'larni qaytarishga urin; bo'lmasa tirik manager'da `docker swarm init --force-new-cluster`, keyin yangi manager'lar qo'sh.

**Muammo:** Deploy qilish kerak, lekin `docker service update` "The swarm does not have a leader" xatosini beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
m1 (tirik)  m2 (down)  m3 (down)   -> 1/3 < quorum 2 -> leader yo'q
--force-new-cluster: m1 holatini saqlab, o'zini yagona manager'li
yangi Raft klaster qiladi -> quorum 1/1
```

**Amalda:**
```sh
# 1. eng xavfsiz: m2/m3 ni qaytar (reboot, disk, tarmoq)
# 2. bo'lmasa — FAQAT bitta manager'da:
docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.11
docker node ls                    # m2, m3 Down
docker node demote m2 m3
docker node rm m2 m3
docker swarm join-token manager   # yangi m4, m5 qo'sh -> 3 manager
```
Eski m2/m3 qaytsa — ularni `docker swarm leave --force` qilib, qayta join qil.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--force-new-cluster` ni ikki manager'da qilish — ikki alohida klaster.
- Eski manager'lar qayta tarmoqqa qo'shilsa va tozalanmagan bo'lsa — chalkashlik.
- Worker'lar o'z-o'zidan yangi klasterga ulanadi, lekin token'larni tekshir.

**Senior nuqta:** Oldini olish: 3 yoki 5 manager turli AZ'da, `availability: drain`, `/var/lib/docker/swarm` muntazam backup va bu runbook'ni staging'da mashq qilish.

42216.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `pgdata` volume `local` driver bilan — har node'da alohida katalog. Scheduler task'ni node2'ga ko'chirganda u yerda **yangi bo'sh volume** yaratildi, Postgres `initdb` qilib toza DB ochdi. Eski ma'lumot node1 diskida qolgan.

**Muammo:** Bu "ma'lumot yo'qoldi" emas, balki **split data**: app yangi bo'sh DB'ga yozishni boshlaydi; node1 qaytsa, ikki xil ma'lumot to'plami bo'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
node1 (o'ldi):  /var/lib/docker/volumes/shop_pgdata  (haqiqiy)
node2 (yangi):  /var/lib/docker/volumes/shop_pgdata  (bo'sh -> initdb)
app ---> node2 DB (yangi yozuvlar shu yerga)
```

**Mitigate:**
```sh
docker service scale shop_db=0          # yangi yozuvlarni to'xtat
# node1'ni tikla yoki diskini ulab ma'lumotni ko'chir
# node2'dagi yangi yozuvlarni pg_dump bilan ajrat va qo'lda birlashtir
```

**To'g'ri yondashuv:**
```yaml
services:
  db:
    deploy:
      placement:
        constraints: [node.labels.db == true]   # faqat bitta node'da label
```
- Pin qilish: node o'lsa DB ham yo'q — lekin bo'sh DB ochilmaydi (xavfsiz fail).
- HA kerak bo'lsa: Patroni replication yoki managed DB (RDS, Cloud SQL).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- NFS ustida Postgres — fsync/locking xavfli, tavsiya etilmaydi.
- Entrypoint "bo'sh katalog = initdb" xatti-harakati — boshqa DB'larda ham (MySQL, Mongo).

**Senior nuqta:** Stateful servis uchun "noto'g'ri joyda ishga tushgandan ko'ra ishga tushmagan yaxshi" (fail closed). Orchestrator'ga ko'chirish erkinligini faqat stateless'ga ber.

42217.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Darhol token'ni rotate qil (`docker swarm join-token --rotate worker`), `docker node ls` bilan begona node bormi tekshir va bo'lsa `node rm --force`. Begona node qo'shilgan bo'lsa — unga tushgan service'larning secret'larini ham rotate qil.

**Muammo:** Worker token bilan istalgan mashina klasterga worker sifatida qo'shiladi; scheduler unga task'lar tushiradi — container'lar, image'lar va **secret'lar** begona qo'lga o'tadi. Manager token esa butun klaster ustidan nazorat.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SWMTKN-1-<CA hash>-<secret>
rotate -> eski secret qismi bekor; mavjud node'lar ta'sirlanmaydi
(token faqat join paytida tekshiriladi)
```

**Amalda:**
```sh
docker swarm join-token --rotate worker
docker swarm join-token --rotate manager    # u ham tarqalgan bo'lsa
docker node ls --format '{{.Hostname}} {{.Status}} {{.ManagerStatus}}'
docker node inspect <id> --format '{{.Status.Addr}}'
docker node update --availability drain <id>
docker node rm --force <id>
docker node ps <id>        # unga qaysi task'lar tushgan edi
docker swarm ca --rotate   # ehtiyotkor holatda
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat token rotate qilib, node ro'yxatini tekshirmaslik — begona node allaqachon ichkarida qoladi.
- Secret rotation'ni unutish — o'g'irlangan parol hali ham ishlaydi.
- 2377/tcp internetga ochiq bo'lsa token yagona himoya.

**Senior nuqta:** Token'ni Slack/wiki'da emas, secret manager'da saqla; node join'ni IaC orqali avtomatlashtir. 2377 faqat ichki tarmoqda — token sizsa ham tashqaridan foydasi yo'q.
